318058.title: Kitakubo's planar emulator conjecture
318058.literal_statement: All graphs considered are finite and simple. A **finite planar emulator** of a graph is a finite emulator whose source graph is planar, and a graph **embeds in the projective plane** when it has a drawing in $\mathbb{R}P^2$ with no edge crossings. **Kitakubo's planar emulator conjecture.** A connected graph has a finite planar emulator if and only if it embeds in the projective plane. Kitakubo proved the corresponding statement for finite planar regular emulators. 329920.title: Inverse conjecture for the large sieve with additively structured sieving sets
329920.literal_statement:
Let $X$ be positive. For each prime $p<X^{1/2}$, let $\Omega_p\subseteq\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$, and let $A\subseteq[1,X]$ be obtained by sieving out the congruence classes in $\Omega_p$. Here a set $\Omega_p$ is **additively structured** if there is an $a\not\equiv0\pmod p$ such that

$$
\left|\sum_{x\in\Omega_p}e\left(\frac{ax}{p}\right)\right|\gg C_pp,
$$

where $C_p\gg\log^{-1}p$.

**Refined inverse conjecture for the large sieve.** Under these assumptions,

$$
|A|\ll X^\epsilon.
$$

The conjecture predicts that simultaneous additive structure in all the sieving sets forces the sifted set to be very small, refining the usual inverse large-sieve conjecture.

316268.title: Minimal difference set embedding conjecture for abelian difference sets
316268.literal_statement:
Let $D$ be a normalized difference set with parameters

$$
((q^s+1)(q^{2s}+1),q^{2s}+q^s+1,q^s+1)
$$

in an abelian group $G$. A difference set with parameters $((q+1)(q^2+1),q^2+q+1,q+1)$ is called a **minimal difference set** when $q=p^r$, where $p$ is prime and $r$ is a power of $2$.

**Minimal difference set embedding conjecture.** The difference set $D$ contains a minimal difference set embedded in it: there exists a subgroup $S$ of $G$ such that

$$
D\cap S=D',
$$

where $D'$ is a minimal difference set.

This conjecture proposes a partial generalization of the known embedding results for planar abelian difference sets. The source presents it as still open, while giving only a partial generalization in the preceding theorem.

331556.title: The Schatten norm conjecture for r-partite graphs
331556.literal_statement:
Let $p>2$, $n\geq r\geq2$, and let $G$ be an $r$-partite graph of order $n$. Let $T_r(n)$ be the Turán graph on $n$ vertices.

**Schatten norm conjecture for r-partite graphs.** If $G$ is an $r$-partite graph of order $n$, then

$$
\|G\|_p<\|T_r(n)\|_p,
$$

unless $G=T_r(n)$.

The analogous assertion is stated as an elementary extremal result for $p=2$. For $p>2$, the paper presents this strict Turán extremality statement as plausible, while the preceding constructions provide lower-bound evidence relevant to the problem.

333821.title: Körner–Malvenuto's maximal colliding-permutations conjecture
333821.literal_statement:
Let $[n]=\{1,\dots,n\}$. Two permutations $\pi_1,\pi_2$ of $[n]$ are **colliding** if there is an index $i\in[n]$ such that $|\pi_1(i)-\pi_2(i)|=1$.

**Körner–Malvenuto's conjecture.** The maximal number of pairwise colliding permutations of $[n]$ is

$$
\binom{n}{\left\lfloor \frac{n}{2} \right\rfloor}.
$$

The paper recalls this earlier extremal question as motivation for studying graph-different Hamiltonian paths. Its status is not specified in the source.

380352.title: Czabarka's conjecture for partially intersecting partition systems
380352.literal_statement:
Let $\mathcal{P}^n_k$ be the family of $k$-partitions of an $n$-set. Two partitions are **partially $2$-intersecting** if some class of one and some class of the other have intersection of size at least $2$; a system is partially $2$-intersecting if every pair is so related. Let $S(n-1,k)$ denote the corresponding extremal quantity used in the source.

**Czabarka's conjecture.** If $n\leq2k-1$ and $\mathcal{P}\subseteq\mathcal{P}^n_k$ is a partially $2$-intersecting partition system, then 
$$
|\mathcal{P}|\leq S(n-1,k).
$$
 

The conjecture is attributed in the source to Czabarka and is cited to Erdős and Székely. The bound is attained by the system of partitions having a class containing a fixed pair.

380367.title: Bessis's cyclic sieving conjecture for the modified action on $m$-divisible noncrossing partitions
380367.literal_statement:
Let $W$ be a well-generated complex reflection group with Coxeter number $h$, let $m\geq 0$, and let $NC^m(W)$ be the set of $m$-divisible noncrossing partitions. Define

$$
\mathrm{Cat}^m(W,q)=\prod_{i=1}^{n}\frac{[mh+d_i]_q}{[d_i]_q}.
$$

Let $C'=\mathbb Z/(m+1)h\mathbb Z$ act on $NC^m(W)$ by the modified cyclic action described in the source.

**Bessis's modified-action CSP conjecture.** The triple

$$
(X,X(q),C')=\left(NC^m(W),\mathrm{Cat}^m(W,q),\mathbb Z/(m+1)h\mathbb Z\right)
$$

exhibits the cyclic sieving phenomenon.

The modified action is related to the action for $NC^{m+1}(W)$ and has an interpretation via the Garside automorphism of the divided category associated with the dual braid monoid. The source gives no resolution status.
